baseline.expected_assertion: once-listener panic poisoned the handler mutex

claim: The current once-listener path queues self-removal before invoking its FnOnce callback. If that callback panics, the baseline poisons the handler mutex and never completes cleanup. The prepared core callback-panic candidate flushes the queued self-removal before resuming the original panic and passes the focused later-delivery control.
limitations: not a full Tauri event test gate
